notes.title: Camera Options!
notes.content:
[b][h1]Thanks for all the testing so far![/h1]
[/b]

[h3]There were a few requests for more camera options and settings. In this latest build you'll find added[/h3]

[list]
[*] Auto Camera Toggle
[*] Auto Camera Follow Strength Slider
[*] Inverted Camera options
[*] Camera Smoothing Options
[/list]

[h3]Additionally, there were a few bugs to squash.[/h3]

[list]
[*] Camera should no longer stuck zoomed in after sword riding on controller.
[*] On first booting the game, the camera sensitivity for the controller will now work as expected.
[*] Climbing through the wall is no longer allowed.
[/list]
